svg.title: Repeated peaks, minute by minute
svg.desc: The measured hour of the repeated-peaks scenario, the sudden jump and the recovery: offered load, share of requests answered within 500 ms and ready pods for each setup.
svg.text: A 75-second peak of about 75 requests per second every 5 minutes, and about 9 requests per second between peaks.
After the measured hour, load jumps to 68 requests per second for 10 minutes, with heavier requests.
Requests answered within 500 ms (each 15 s window)
